protocol: local finite-budget RL-1 through RL-4, v1
baseline_selection: minimum training objective per lambda, no test tuning
checkpoint_selection: minimum full-validation cost + lambda*violations, fixed lambda
ablation_penalty_selection: from main configurations' validation seed means; feasible cheapest, otherwise least violating
test_exposure_caveat: Azure days 12-14 were used by earlier ML work; this protocol freezes choices before a new final evaluation batch.
limitations: finite sample budget; convergence is not assumed
common routing adapter for AUTO/SPOCK target controllers; not a claim of exact original queue semantics
equal candidate cap does not imply equal training compute
